verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI research service like Sakana Marlin, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, data-use controls or privacy settings. The pack covers only research capabilities, pricing and credits.
